document.about: Herman Miller Aeron chair product sheet (2 pages). Page 2's Details sets small blocks of fields, label beside value, under bold block labels, beside ruled tables and a column of benefits.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#163): a list of fields set without rules, label beside value row after row, was run together into one paragraph when its labels end in no colon or when it shares its baselines with another page column.

checks.issue: `Overview Maximum user weight size A 300 lb/136 kg …` was one paragraph.
The last row sets `Optional` closer to its long label than cells are parted.
